content.title: Where is High Point University? - High Point University
content.text: Where Is High Point University? High Point University (HPU) is located in the vibrant city of High Point, North Carolina—a growing hub of innovation, education, and opportunity. Nestled in the heart of the Piedmont Triad region, HPU is easily accessible from major cities like Greensboro, Winston-Salem, and Charlotte, making it an ideal location for students seeking a dynamic college experience. How to Get to High Point University Located just 20 minutes from Piedmont Triad International Airport (GSO) and within driving distance of major highways, HPU offers convenience for both students and visitors. If you’re traveling from out of state, the university is approximately: 1.5 hours from Charlotte, NC 2 hours from Raleigh, NC 4.5 hours from Washington, D.C. A Premier Campus in North Carolina High Point University’s beautiful and inspiring campus spans hundreds of acres, featuring state-of-the-art academic buildings, award winning dorms, and a strong sense of community. With a focus on academic excellence and career readiness, HPU is consistently ranked #1 top regional colleges in the South by U.S. News & World Report. High Point University has also been named the #1 Best Run College in America. What’s Near High Point University? High Point is known as the “Home Furnishings Capital of the World”, hosting the High Point Market, the largest home furnishings trade show in the world. Students also enjoy nearby attractions such as: Downtown High Point – Home to unique restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues. Greensboro & Winston-Salem – Offering cultural attractions, music festivals, and internship opportunities. Outer Banks and other beaches- Get ready for fun in the sun. Asheville– Paradise in the mountains is only a few hours away. Why Choose High Point University? Students choose HPU not just for its location but for its innovative approach to education. With a commitment to personalized learning, professional development, and extraordinary campus life, High Point University provides an unparalleled student experience in a city that continues to grow and thrive. Visit High Point University Interested in visiting HPU? Schedule a campus tour and experience firsthand why students from across the country call High Point, NC, home. High Point University’s Address One University Parkway, High Point, NC 27268
